name: RANDCorporation/ROMANCER
description: RAND Ontological Model for Assessing Nuclear Crisis Escalation Risk (ROMANCER) is a model that represents nuclear escalation behaviours, and includes multiple theories-of-mind that afford exploration of decisionmakers taking actions, and making threats and demands, to see how this might affect nuclear escalation outcomes.
score_rationale: Nuclear crisis escalation risk model with scenario exploration.
summary: Models nuclear crisis escalation risk and decision dynamics.
